title: MetEV
subtitle: Web Developer
description: I worked as a web developer for MetEV, a startup focused on electric vehicles. My role involved developing and maintaining the company's website and web applications.
contributions: Engineered user-centric frontend components with Next.js and Tailwind CSS.
Led the development of the checkout flow through state management, cookies, and form validation.
Worked in a team of four to build a website for a startup, from ideation and wireframing to final deployment.
Engaged in interdepartmental brainstorming sessions for the startup.

media.alt: MetEV team arranging an electric bicycle for a product photoshoot

items.hoverText: My role extended beyond development. I worked with other teams on product photography, gathered user feedback, and carried out research to help shape our content decisions.

media.alt: MetEV team working together around a table with laptops

items.hoverText: We brought our ideas together to set goals and plan the work. We divided responsibilities and merged our work in Git each week to keep development moving smoothly.

media.alt: MetEV team presenting their project at the RMIT showcase

items.hoverText: At the RMIT showcase, we spoke with students about MetEV’s goals, answered their questions, and shared what we were working towards.

media.alt: MetEV checkout interface with bicycle selection, financing, and color options

items.hoverText: I focused on making the checkout experience feel seamless, using smooth transitions and keeping selections intuitive as users moved through the process.

media.alt: MetEV website interface mockups with product features and a laptop preview

items.hoverText: I built reusable components and adapted them for different pages, helping the website feel consistent and making future updates easier.
